title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #12

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What should a Muslim say before starting to read the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Only Alhamdulillah
   B. Nothing at all
   C. Only Allahu Akbar
   D. Seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah

2. Which surah teaches us to thank Allah and stay humble when we succeed? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Masad
   C. Al-Kafirun
   D. Al-Falaq

3. What does "akhlaq" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Direction of prayer
   B. Prayer times
   C. Fasting
   D. Character and manners

4. What does Islam teach about lying, even in jokes? (1 mark)
   A. Lying is a Sunnah
   B. The Prophet avoided lying even in jokes
   C. Lying is allowed to friends
   D. Jokes are always lies

5. Who is the best example of good character for Muslims? (1 mark)
   A. A game character
   B. Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   C. A rich businessman
   D. A film star

6. When eating with others from one dish, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Reach across for the best piece
   B. Push others
   C. Take the whole dish
   D. Eat from your own side of the dish

7. Why do we wash our hands before eating? (1 mark)
   A. To keep food and ourselves clean
   B. To make the meal longer
   C. To waste water
   D. It is only for adults

8. Why should Muslims not overeat? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us fast
   B. It is a sport
   C. It saves money
   D. It can make us sick and lazy

9. What should a Muslim say before eating? (1 mark)
   A. Alhamdulillah
   B. Astaghfirullah
   C. Bismillah
   D. Subhanallah

10. In the Prophet's teaching, before every prayer the siwak was (1 mark)
   A. Forbidden
   B. Compulsory on children only
   C. Strongly encouraged but not made compulsory
   D. Required only for sick people

11. What should a boy cover at least while playing sports? (1 mark)
   A. From the navel to the knees
   B. Nothing
   C. Only the head
   D. Only the hands

12. What does "Ar-Rahman" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The King
   B. The All-Hearing
   C. The Most Kind, whose mercy is for all
   D. The All-Seeing

13. When the Qur'an (20:46) says Allah is with Musa and Harun "hearing and seeing", which names are shown? (1 mark)
   A. As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   B. Ar-Rahim and As-Salam
   C. Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
   D. Al-Malik and As-Salam

14. How should we describe Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Like a big man
   B. Nothing is like Him
   C. Like a king on earth
   D. Like an angel

15. Why should belief in Raqib and Atid help us behave well? (1 mark)
   A. They give sweets
   B. They punish us at once
   C. Our words and actions are recorded
   D. They laugh at us

16. Who is called "Ar-Ruh al-Amin", the Trustworthy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Raqib
   B. Mikail
   C. Israfil
   D. Jibril

17. Which surah verse says angels do not disobey Allah's command? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 112:1
   B. Qur'an 66:6
   C. Qur'an 110:3
   D. Qur'an 1:2

18. Who is the last prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Sulaiman
   B. Yahya
   C. Isa
   D. Muhammad (S.A.W.)

19. Which prophet is the ancestor of Yaqub? (1 mark)
   A. Musa
   B. Dawud
   C. Harun
   D. Ishaq

20. A baby girl's urine falls on a mat. What type of najasa is it? (1 mark)
   A. Medium
   B. Heavy
   C. Not a najasa
   D. Light

21. If there is solid matter of a najasa, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Cover it
   B. Sprinkle perfume
   C. Remove it
   D. Ignore it

22. What is a mughalladha najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A light najasa
   C. A medium najasa
   D. A heavy najasa

23. How far are the feet washed? (1 mark)
   A. Up to and including the ankles
   B. Heels only
   C. Knees
   D. Toes only

24. Which prayer has three rak'ahs? (1 mark)
   A. Maghrib
   B. Asr
   C. Isha
   D. Fajr

25. Which prayer begins at midday after the sun passes its highest point? (1 mark)
   A. Dhuhr
   B. Isha
   C. Fajr
   D. Maghrib

26. How many rak'ahs does Isha have? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Two
   C. Three
   D. Four

27. Which is a pillar and not a condition? (1 mark)
   A. Time of prayer
   B. Facing the Qibla
   C. Ruku
   D. Wudhu

28. What do we say when sitting between the two sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah
   B. La ilaha
   C. Rabbighfir li
   D. Amin

29. Which is a way of showing kindness to a working donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving it in the sun
   B. Overloading it
   C. Giving water and rest
   D. Beating it

30. In the Prophet's story, a woman was punished because she (1 mark)
   A. Starved a cat she had tied up
   B. Fed a cat
   C. Adopted a cat
   D. Gave a cat milk

31. A girl wants to play football modestly. Which outfit suits? (1 mark)
   A. A see-through top
   B. A very tight top
   C. Tracksuit with long trousers and sports headscarf
   D. A torn shirt

32. Which of these is print media? (1 mark)
   A. Newspaper
   B. Radio
   C. Television
   D. Film

33. Why is it bad when children are made to beg? (1 mark)
   A. It helps them study
   B. They miss school and face danger
   C. It makes them strong
   D. They learn a lot

34. Why do we say the dua for leaving home? (1 mark)
   A. To seek Allah's protection
   B. To pass time
   C. To be loud
   D. To be fashionable

35. Why are children called an amanah? (1 mark)
   A. They are servants
   B. They are property
   C. They are a trust from Allah
   D. They are strangers

36. What can a child do if parents are poor and cannot buy everything? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse to speak
   B. Steal
   C. Complain loudly
   D. Be patient and make dua for them

37. Which is an example of respect? (1 mark)
   A. Greeting parents with a smile
   B. Answering back
   C. Interrupting
   D. Ignoring

38. Which qualities of the Prophet did Khadija mention? (1 mark)
   A. He is careless
   B. He keeps ties, helps the weak and honours guests
   C. He is rude
   D. He is lazy

39. What does "Qalam" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sword
   B. Cave
   C. Pen
   D. Book

40. How did the leaders of Taif respond? (1 mark)
   A. They rejected him rudely
   B. They accepted at once
   C. They gave him gifts
   D. They joined him

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the hadith on physical fitness given in your syllabus. (2 marks)

42. Explain why wudhu is important in the life of a Muslim. (4 marks)

43. State the duties of Malakul Maut and of Raqib and Atid. (2 marks)

44. What is an attribute of Allah? Give one example. (2 marks)

45. State three duties to grandparents. (3 marks)

46. Write the seven surahs studied in this lesson and give the number of verses in any three of them. (5 marks)

47. Explain how Ibrahim and Ismail (A.S.) showed obedience to Allah. (4 marks)

48. Name two dressing trends a Muslim should avoid. (2 marks)

49. Give one example of each type of najasa. (3 marks)

50. Why do Muslims all over the world face the Qibla? (4 marks)

51. Describe one complete rak'ah in order. (4 marks)

52. How can you apply the teaching of Al-Falaq about envy in your daily life? (3 marks)

53. What was the Prophet's reply to the angel of the mountains? (3 marks)

54. State three groups of people who deserve help. (3 marks)

55. Why is it wrong to pray on time but shout at your family? (3 marks)

56. What do we say in ruku, in sujud and when sitting between the two sujud? (3 marks)

57. List the steps of brushing teeth correctly. (3 marks)

58. Give three effects of belief in angels on a Muslim's life. (3 marks)

59. Give two good habits that keep a toothbrush healthy. (2 marks)

60. In which cave, and near which city, did the first revelation come? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah
   This is the recommended way to begin recitation.

2. A — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr speaks of victory and tells us to praise Allah and ask forgiveness.

3. D — Character and manners
   Akhlaq means moral character.

4. B — The Prophet avoided lying even in jokes
   The Prophet was always truthful.

5. B — Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   The Qur'an praises his great character.

6. D — Eat from your own side of the dish
   The hadith teaches eating from what is in front of you.

7. A — To keep food and ourselves clean
   Cleanliness is part of good manners and health.

8. D — It can make us sick and lazy
   Moderation keeps us healthy.

9. C — Bismillah
   We begin by mentioning Allah's name.

10. C — Strongly encouraged but not made compulsory
   He said he would have ordered it if not hard.

11. A — From the navel to the knees
   This is the minimum covering.

12. C — The Most Kind, whose mercy is for all
   Ar-Rahman shows Allah's mercy to all creation.

13. A — As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   Allah hears and sees.

14. B — Nothing is like Him
   Allah is not compared to His creation.

15. C — Our words and actions are recorded
   We try to speak and do good.

16. D — Jibril
   This title refers to Jibril.

17. B — Qur'an 66:6
   Surah At-Tahrim 66:6 states this.

18. D — Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   Qur'an 33:40 calls him Seal of the Prophets.

19. D — Ishaq
   Yaqub was the son of Ishaq.

20. A — Medium
   Baby girl's urine is washed as medium najasa in this teaching.

21. C — Remove it
   Remove the substance first.

22. D — A heavy najasa
   Mughalladha means heavy.

23. A — Up to and including the ankles
   To the ankles.

24. A — Maghrib
   Maghrib has three.

25. A — Dhuhr
   Dhuhr begins after the sun passes noon.

26. D — Four
   Isha has four.

27. C — Ruku
   Ruku is inside the prayer.

28. C — Rabbighfir li
   My Lord, forgive me.

29. C — Giving water and rest
   Working animals need care.

30. A — Starved a cat she had tied up
   She did not feed it or let it find food.

31. C — Tracksuit with long trousers and sports headscarf
   It allows free movement and modesty.

32. A — Newspaper
   Print media is printed on paper.

33. B — They miss school and face danger
   Children should be protected.

34. A — To seek Allah's protection
   We ask for protection.

35. C — They are a trust from Allah
   Parents must care for them.

36. D — Be patient and make dua for them
   Understand their situation.

37. A — Greeting parents with a smile
   Respect is shown by manners.

38. B — He keeps ties, helps the weak and honours guests
   She praised his character.

39. C — Pen
   Allah taught by the pen.

40. A — They rejected him rudely
   They refused.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Teach your children swimming, archery and horse riding.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the skills and 1 mark for the instruction to teach children.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: It is required for prayer; it cleans and refreshes; it brings reward; it prepares the heart for meeting Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Malakul Maut takes souls at death. Raqib and Atid record our deeds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: A quality that describes Allah, for example Ar-Rahman, the Most Kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a correct example.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Respect and greet them, help them, visit them, listen to their stories, make dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha (7), Al-Kafirun (6), An-Nasr (3), Al-Masad (5), Al-Ikhlas (4), Al-Falaq (5), An-Naas (6). Any three with correct number of verses.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for naming all seven (award proportionally), 1 mark for three correct verse counts.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ibrahim was told in a dream to sacrifice his son, Ismail said to do as commanded and that he would be patient, and both were ready. Allah replaced Ismail with a ram.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for Ismail's reply, 1 mark for readiness, 1 mark for the ram.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tight or see-through clothes, and clothes with rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Light: urine of a baby boy on milk only; medium: urine, stool, blood or vomit; heavy: dog or pig saliva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah commanded it in the Qur'an (2:144). It unites Muslims and shows that we worship one Lord.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for command, 1 mark for the verse or Kaaba, 1 mark for unity, 1 mark for one Lord.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: Stand and recite Al-Fatiha, bow, rise, first sujud, sit, second sujud, then stand or sit for tashahhud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair of steps.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Seek Allah's protection from envy, be happy when others do well, and do not wish harm on them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for seeking refuge, 1 mark for being happy for others, 1 mark for not wishing harm.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused to let the people be destroyed and hoped Allah would bring from their descendants people who worship Allah alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for refusal, 1 mark for hope, 1 mark for descendants.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: People in debt, people who lost property through disaster, and the destitute.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Islam teaches that faith includes good manners. The Prophet was sent to perfect good morals, so prayer and character go together.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for faith including manners, 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the conclusion.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ruku: Subhana Rabbiyal Azim; sujud: Subhana Rabbiyal A'la; sitting: Rabbighfir li.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah, use a pea-sized amount of paste, brush outer, inner and chewing surfaces, brush the tongue, rinse and store the brush.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct group of steps up to 3.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: More honesty, more thankfulness, respect for the Qur'an, remembering death and the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid effect.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do not share it and change it when the bristles are bent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each habit.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cave of Hira near Makkah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the cave and 1 mark for the city.
